articles.title: Save Big on Viture’s XR Glasses for Black Friday
articles.summary: Searching for a new display to take your gaming to the next level? XR glasses have a lot of potential, packing what looks like a massive display into a compact pair of glasses you can take with you almost anywhere.
body: The Viture Beast landed this year at $549, but they’re on sale for $489 through Cyber Monday. Our reviewer, Jacqueline Thomas, said in her review, “the Viture Beast XR glasses are a great way to kick back on a flight and play games on a handheld without having to hold up a bulky device the entire way.”

These are the flagship glasses from the brand, offering some substantial tech inside. The Virture Beast pack in a pair of 1200p Micro-OLED displays that run at 120Hz. If that sounds like a brilliant recipe for gaming to you, you’ve clearly been doing your homework on display technology. The OLED displays give you rich contrast — especially with the 1,250-nit peak brightness — vivid color, and fast pixel response times on top of the fluid visual you already get from that refresh rate. The extra brightness of the displays can help if you’re using the glasses out in the daylight, but if you want to maximize the clarity, Viture uses electrochromic dimming that can cut down on external light.

articles.title: Mario, Pikachu, And Other Gaming Icon Balloons Won’t Be Flying This Thanksgiving
articles.summary: New York City is no stranger to bad weather, be it blazing-hot summers, snow-packed winters, or fierce windstorms. Unfortunately for countless families who have made it a holiday tradition to turn on the TV and watch giant totems of pop culture sail in the streets of the great city, the Macy's…
body: In recent years, gaming icons have become more and more prominent during the parade. Beginning in 1993, a balloon of Sonic the Hedgehog marked the first game character to float among the procession. Since then, more characters have joined the festivities, including Mario, Pac-Man, Pikachu, and even Red the Angry Bird, among others.

However, those who have followed the history of Macy's balloons know that the mix of bad weather and massive, floating objects can result in genuine danger for balloon handlers, bystanders, and objects on the streets. Rather infamously, Sonic's 1993 appearance was marred by an incident where the balloon got stuck on a lamppost, popping the balloon and injuring two bystanders.

Other balloon bursts have proved even more catastrophic, with a series of mishaps in 1997 leading to a Cat in the Hat balloon causing injuries that left a woman comatose for days. Since then, more emphasis has rightfully been put on safety.

articles.title: 10 Classic Books Worth Reading Over and Over
articles.summary: Most of us treat classic literature like a checklist to conquer in high school or college and then never touch those books again. You power through the plot, underline a few quotes for a term paper, and move on to whatever else is new.
body: When you reread classic literature, everything changes: you stop rushing toward the finale and focus instead on how the author pulled it all off. Whether they reshape your perspective as you age or hide their best clues in plain sight, these 10 books reward you on every return trip.

Dostoevsky borrows the mechanics of a detective novel as he weaves Raskolnikov’s psychological fallout into the overriding mystery, setting aside the familiar detective-versus-killer plot to peer into the killer’s mind​​​​​​​. When you aren't racing through its pages to see whether Raskolnikov gets caught by the investigator Porfiry Petrovich, you savor the cat-and-mouse mind games between them. Every feverish rationalization and defensive outburst reads like a man slowly building his own prison cell.

articles.title: Three Years After His Death, EA Is Using AI To Bring Back A Famed Commentator In FC 27
articles.summary: EA Sports FC 27 is adding an AI-generated commentator for the first time in the series' history, with famed British commentator John Motson having his voice synthesized for the football title.
body: Motson, who passed way in 2023, previously provided commentary for EA's FIFA series, appearing in the game's first iteration in 1996 and featuring until 2005. According to the BBC, EA approached Motson's wife and son for permission to regenerate his voice and use his likeness for this year's entry in the series. Both agreed to the idea, but neither party has disclosed how much EA has paid for the use. Fred Motson, John's son, stated that he believed his father would've approved of this use of AI.

"My dad was the least technological person in the world," Fred stated. "Till his dying day, he had a typewriter on his desk. So I don't think he would have quite understood what the AI was doing technologically, but I think, on the other hand, he was always really keen to get involved in these kinds of projects."

This caused a problem, as players discovered when they made it to some of the adult scenes only to find dialogue in which characters repeated at each other, "I can't provide a translation for explicit sexual content."

Players are unimpressed, with the Steam user rating dropping to Mostly Negative. As one user review puts it, "What if you want to goon But God says I'm unable to provide a translation for this text because it contains explicit sexual content."

Other user reviews complain about changes to the original artwork, with characters having accessories like teddy bears and hair ribbons taken away, as well as being given larger breasts or made to look taller. It's tougher to emphasize with players who are mad that characters in an adult game have been changed to look less like 12-year-olds, especially given the pressure put on Valve by payment processors to remove certain kinds of games from Steam.

articles.title: Diablo 4’s Most Nostalgic Season Is Becoming (Mostly) Permanent
articles.summary: Diablo 4 is gearing up for the arrival of Season 16, but it won't be leaving its popular previous season behind entirely. As detailed by Blizzard in a breakdown of the upcoming Season of Tyrael's Gambit, much of the previous season, Hell's Legacy, will become a permanent part of Diablo 4 going…
body: Most of that is carrying forward, Blizzard said. Due to "overwhelming requests" from the game's community, Blizzard outlined what all from Hell's Legacy will survive.

Hell's Legacy's capstone dungeons will be added, as will the ability to summon a World Boss version of Diablo and take on the cow god Moopisto. The Prime Evil Council is also becoming permanent, and will work the same way the game's other Lair bosses do, with players needing a specific item to open their reward chest after successfully defeating the encounter.

Waking Nightmare dungeons will still be accessible, but only by finding Chronicle of Nightmares dungeon keys. Monsters from previous Diablo games will also have a chance to spawn in The Pit. Those who progressed their secret cow level journey can also rejoice, as the secret cow island and its corresponding waypoint will be staying.

Many of Hell's Legacy's best items were new versions of classics from older Diablo games, and those Legacy Uniques will be added permanently as well, including the Annihilus Seal and Hellfire Torch Charm.

articles.title: Ridley Scott’s Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Is Officially Being Removed From Netflix
articles.summary: Ridley Scott is one of those staple filmmakers. The 88-year-old English director has made countless noteworthy films, TV shows, and commercials over the course of his prolific career, dabbling in so many genres that it’s difficult to narrow down the parameters of his work.
body: One of his most famous films, however, is also one of his sparsest. After making his feature debut with the small but well-received The Duelists, Scott delivered his follow-up: Alien, one of the great sci-fi horror films of all time. The 1979 classic gave the space-horror subgenre the Scott treatment, resulting in a modest-budget film that looks gorgeous and frightening, balancing evocative monsters and sets with a quiet restraint no entries in the franchise have matched since. With Alien Netflix on Dec. 1, there's never been a better time to rewatch it.

Set in an unspecified future, Alien follows the Nostromo, a towing ship hauling resources back to Earth. The ship’s crew is made up of workers struggling to make ends meet, hoping to wrap up the job and return home to cash in their paychecks. They awaken from hypersleep after the ship’s computer, Mother, receives a signal from a nearby moon, tasking them with exploring it. Three members of the crew set out to investigate, arriving in an environment that’s hostile from the get-go and quickly get caught in a storm that damages the ship.

articles.title: Another Live-Service Game Is Going Extinct, And This One Has Dinosaurs
articles.summary: Capcom has had a big year, but amid the hits comes news that its Overwatch-with-dinosaurs game, Exoprimal, will join the live-service graveyard next year. The game's servers will go offline next year, making it unplayable after that.
body: "Thank you so much for your continued use of Exoprimal, a statement on the Exoprimal site reads. "We regret to announce that service for Exoprimal will be discontinued as of Thursday, September 30, 2027. We cannot thank you enough for the love and support you have shown over the years, and we sincerely apologize for the gravity of this announcement."

Exoprimal season passes are no longer available to purchase through storefronts, and Capcom will slowly wind down the game over several months. Exoprimal and all its DLC will be delisted from stores starting March 30, 2027, but anyone who owns it can still download and play it before the September 2027 deadline. Despite a cool premise and fun gameplay, Exoprimal never truly took off after its 2023 launch.

articles.title: How to get adrenaline in GTA 6
articles.summary: Adrenaline acts as an emergency boost to all your stats in Grand Theft Auto 6, as it temporarily negates health, stamina, and focus loss. It's meant to get you out of an emergency situation safely or help you burst into a tense situation and mop it up fast.
body: This is not to be confused with the other robbery opportunities that have green markers or stick ups that have gray markers. These areas can have adrenaline, but they're a bit rarer.

There's also a chance to find adrenaline in the back of ambulances, either loose or in a trauma kit. Getting it this way is pretty tough until you reach Chapter 3 and can explore Vice City more freely, though. The city hospital always has a few ambulances around back in the parking lot. They aren't very well attended, so you can break in with comparative ease. They are alarmed, so make sure to slim jim the door first, and then open the back to avoid setting off the alarm.

You might see ambulances driving along the roads of Leonida or the streets of Vice City. If you're really desperate for adrenaline, you can stop them and break into the back. This is a pretty big and unnecessary risk to take if you're trying to keep a low profile, though.

articles.title: All Missing Persons locations in GTA 6
articles.summary: Catch Port Gellhorn's creepy serial killer and end the 20-year mystery.
body: The GTA 6 Missing Persons case is available as early as Chapter 1, but you'll need access to both Lucia and Jason to wrap up the side quest in Chapter 2. Your stint as a fledgling detective begins in an abandoned warehouse near Mo's shop in Gellhorn, though there are two ways to flag the objective on your map and start the hunt for Gellhorn's serial killer.

If you begin in Chapter 1 when you can only play as Jason, head straight to the abandoned warehouse to begin. This is how I began the quest the first time, after following a pack of coyotes through a small opening on the side of the abandoned warehouse. This route gives you an extra text conversation where Jason sends Lucia creepy photos from the warehouse.

Begin in Chapter 2 by heading to the Starlet Motel lobby in Gellhorn and inspecting the missing persons posters. Afterward, head to the abandoned warehouse as a couple or go alone, and squeeze through the crawl space.

articles.title: The Fable reboot had to look beyond Lionhead's RPG trilogy because games like The Witcher 3 "became the gold standard"
articles.summary: Developer Playground Games had to look beyond Lionhead's original run of Fable games when rebooting the classic fantasy series, and it's all thanks to games like The Witcher 3, which changed what many players expect from their big RPGs and set a new "gold standard."
body: The upcoming Fable reboot is finally ending its decade-long development journey soon. Playground Games had to set up an entirely new team to work on its fairytale revival, so Fable's production wasn't quite as smooth sailing as the studio's consistently excellent Forza Horizon series, for example.

Asked about what's changed during that time, in an interview with GamesIndustry.biz, studio founder and general manager Ralph Fulton named technological advancements as a biggie, but the impact of other games was perhaps even greater.

"In 2015, The Witcher 3 redefined what an open-world action RPG looks like and became the gold standard," Fulton said. "And after that bar was raised, the Assassin's Creed franchise changed into this more modern iteration with Origins, Odyssey, and Valhalla, and became like a quasi-RPG."

"All of these games continue to reset player expectations," he continued. Millions of players suddenly had certain expectations about what their big-budget, open-world role-playing games should look like. So, Playground couldn't pull inspiration from Fable and Fable alone.

In this IGN guide video, we'll show you where to find every car on Randy's Wish List, what each vehicle looks like, and the best areas to search.
We'll also explain how to unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, how Randy's vehicle intel works, and how to repair vehicles before delivering them.

body: Answer Betilla's call and join Rayman, Globox, Barbara, and Grand Minimus on a perilous adventure. Explore a mysterious realm, face a powerful new villain, and uncover the source of the corruption before the Glade is lost forever.
